theme: An open Saturday — a few trips still waiting to be booked.
greeting: A wide-open Saturday, Dan, with the girls at Jen's and nothing on the calendar until tomorrow's short review. Good day to finally close out the travel bookings that keep circling the board.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV rental out of Portland for Christmas week has sat open on your board with Mike since mid-September, flagged p1 — it's the thinnest holiday inventory in that market, so a refundable hold now takes the risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December family trip
needsAttention.detail: The December-break pick was meant to be booked by Oct 15. All four girls, a 21-day window, holiday inventory for six — the booking slot is closing, so this is the weekend to choose and hold it.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review — and the Pathfinder window
needsAttention.detail: Your 15-minute review with Mike is tomorrow at 9 AM on your calendar, landing just as the Oct 5–18 window to drive the Pathfinder south closes — worth settling this weekend whether that drive still happens or flips to flights.

flagged.title: Brunswick Group lining up two meetings
flagged.detail: Invites came Oct 15 for Teams calls with Christian Buss and Jonathan Doorley — both still unread; accepting them onto your calendar locks the times.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley funding reminder
flagged.detail: A 'final reminder' to fund your new Signature Savings account — confirm it's an account you opened before acting on it.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and promos — FT, Faherty, Mandarin Oriental, two language-learning pitches, a Todoist digest, and the St. Pete local sends.

resolved: Toronto trip locked in — the Airbnb loft and Kiwi flights for Nov 2–5 both came through confirmed.

recipe.why: Autumn roots and bitter greens are at their peak now, made for slow roasting.

The day stays open; no meetings land at all.
A quiet evening before the week restarts tomorrow.
